Microsoft Azure Get Subscriptions Subscriptionid Resourcegroups Resourcegroupname Providers Microsoft Datalakestore Accounts Accountname Trustedidproviders

params.name: subscriptionId

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the Azure resource group.
